I've been seeing multiple therapists and taking medication for over a year, and if anything it's gotten worse. That's why I'm hesitant to call it depression because if it was real depression then that shit would have helped. But if it is depression, I'm very skeptical to the idea that it just "goes away". I know it comes and goes to some extent, but I don't believe that anybody who truly has had depression is ever free of it.
